summary: Two experienced backcountry skiers overdue in the Gore Range spent a night out after cell phone and InReach batteries died; caught between ascending a ridge in a lightning storm or descending unknown rough terrain. SCRG found them uninjured and they walked out on their own.
notes: Added run 771 (SnowBrains chunk); Sunday-verified 2022-07-17; incident called in July 17, pair rescued next day.
